pageHeader.title: template migrations
pageHeader.description: plan and track migrations of assets from one template to another.

info.title: What is a Migration Plan?
info.description: A Migration Plan moves a set of assets from a source template to a target template, in controlled batches, immediately or on a schedule.

batches.title: Controlled Batches
batches.text: Migrate assets in configurable batch sizes to keep the platform responsive

scheduling.title: Immediate or Scheduled
scheduling.text: Run a plan right away or schedule it for a future maintenance window

tracking.title: Progress Tracking
tracking.text: Follow each plan through its lifecycle with live progress and error counters

empty.title: no migration plans
empty.description: create a migration plan to move assets between templates.
